notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::createRegion and its successful HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery through the standard MIM. Region lifecycle behavior maps to clause 9.1.2; successful service invocation reporting and its interaction content map to clauses 11.5 and 11.5.1. The scenario creates a region with service reporting disabled, enables MOM delivery, invokes CreateRegion, and checks the standard set-of-dimension-designators argument (type 11), returned region designator (type 42), success and empty-exception fields, serial zero, region service type 5, reliable delivery, and inherited HLAfederate reporter identity. It then disables reporting and deletes the region through the standard API. It makes no region-based routing assertion and does not assert conditional failure-report payloads. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration.
